promises.label: EBITDA margin guidance
promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
promises.quote: And what the guidance we have given more than 27% EBITDA, we are confident to achieve by the year-end.

promises.label: Order inflow excluding QRSAM
promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
promises.quote: So we are confident that we will definitely achieve more than INR 27,000 crores order book -- order received in this financial year other than QRSAM.

promises.label: Project Kusha production order
promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
promises.quote: So we are expecting order by December 2029, the first production order for us because right now, it is that way is the prototype developmental order which we have received.

promises.label: Revenue growth guidance
promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
promises.quote: So I will again reiterate our commitment that revenue growth, we are going to have 15% plus EBITDA margin, definitely 27%.

promises.label: Order inflow including QRSAM
promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
promises.quote: Order inflow as we committed other than QRSAM, INR 27,000 crores. And including QRSAM, it will be around INR 57,000 crores.

promises.label: Capex guidance
promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
promises.quote: R&D investments more than INR 1,600 crores, capex more than INR 1,000 crores with a defense and nondefense business ratio of 90% to 10%, which is our typical ratio.

reported.label: Revenue from operations
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: So this H1, we have achieved revenue from operations, we have increased it to INR 10,180 crores as compared to INR 8,782 crores up to Q2 of last year with a growth of 15.92%.

reported.label: Revenue growth
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: So this H1, we have achieved revenue from operations, we have increased it to INR 10,180 crores as compared to INR 8,782 crores up to Q2 of last year with a growth of 15.92%.

reported.label: Profit before tax
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: Profit before tax, that has increased to INR 3,023 crores up to Q2 of this year as compared to comparable period of last year, INR 2,488 crores with a growth of 21.5% Profit after tax

reported.label: Profit after tax
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: Profit after tax, that has increased to INR 2,255 crores up to Q2 as compared to INR 1,867 crores up to Q2 last year with a growth of 20.77%.

reported.label: EBITDA margin
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: EBITDA has increased to 30.15% as compared to 27.26% up to Q2 last year.

reported.label: Order book position
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: The order book position as on 1st October '25 is INR 74,453 crores and as on today, it has become INR 75,600 crores.

reported.label: Orders acquired in financial year
reported.speaker: Manoj Jain
reported.quote: Orders acquired till 1st October '25 in this financial year is INR 12,539 crores and till today, it is INR 14,750 crores.
